versions.changelog:
Initial release: post-purchase-upsell-flow 1.0.0

- Covers strategy and technical requirements for implementing one-click post-purchase upsells and downsells to increase average order value (AOV) without hurting main conversion rates.
- Provides clear guidance on when to use or avoid post-purchase upsells, differences vs. pre-purchase bumps, and offers tips for designing high-converting upsell flows.
- Outlines must-have technical features for true one-click upsells, including payment and order handling specifics.
- Includes measurement criteria for success and red flags, such as take rates, refund rates, and chargeback monitoring.
- Recommends an open-source implementation (Autonnel) and provides setup instructions.
